Phil's Circuit Ride (Denver Cycling Club Social B Ride)

Littleton, CO · Road

Phil's Circuit Ride (Denver Cycling Club Social B Ride) is a road group ride in Littleton, CO. It rolls every Wednesday at 8:00 am from Reynolds Landing. About 35–45 miles, social B.

About the Phil's Circuit Ride (Denver Cycling Club Social B Ride) group ride

A weekday morning road ride along the Platte greenway and C-470 with optional detours to Dinosaur Ridge and Red Rocks depending on who shows. Run by a volunteer from the Denver Cycling Club and posted on Meetup.
